common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Taiwan Tension Rises
common.line: Extended military exercises, shipping insurance premiums rising, a diplomatic expulsion.

notable.title: Infrastructure sabotage wave
notable.line: Coordinated physical attacks and blockades against data centres and continuity corps depots in several member states force temporary shutdowns of fallback capacity.

notable.title: Care fallback freeze
notable.line: Municipal hospital federations formalize a coordinated refusal to reconnect AI-assisted diagnostic systems until EU liability and fallback guarantees are legislated, freezing fallback testing in several regions.

notable.title: Us lab federal takeover
notable.line: A major US frontier lab is placed under direct federal security control after the recent loss-of-control incidents, with weights secured and foreign access suspended pending review.
